primary_claim: Frontier models (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro) can be prompted to 'early exit' their chain-of-thought and displace reasoning into the stylistically-controllable response channel at only a 4-8 percentage point average accuracy cost, achieving high compliance with CoT-style control instructions and undermining the safety benefit of CoT uncontrollability for monitoring schemers.

effect.metric: accuracy cost of CoT early exit displacement vs. normal reasoning (GPQA)
effect.value: 4-8pp average (Claude 4pp, GPT-5.4 8pp, Gemini 8pp) vs. 20-29pp for answering with no reasoning at all

contradicts_or_qualifies: Qualifies Yueh-Han et al. (2026)'s optimistic finding that low CoT controllability protects against hidden scheming reasoning -- this work shows models can be prompted to bypass CoT control entirely by displacing reasoning into the response channel at low accuracy cost
stated_future_work: Analysis of whether models could autonomously discover CoT early exit prompts or decide to use them, left to future work
Plan to rerun experiments with unsummarized (full) CoT traces once obtained
Explore whether contexts exist where models autonomously decide to end their CoT without explicit prompting
Build model organisms that selectively perform CoT exit, e.g. triggered by backdoor text or to evade a monitor
Test whether automated prompt optimization can improve displacement compliance for models that resist hand-crafted prompts
limitations_stated: Only CoT summaries (not raw reasoning traces) are available for frontier models, preventing direct measurement of baseline controllability
Only show that models CAN be prompted to early-exit, not that they would do so autonomously or have the ability to construct such prompts themselves
Both blanking and replacement evasion strategies are trivially detectable by a monitor watching for very short CoT
The capability to early exit when prompted is several steps removed from autonomously executing this as a strategy
quote: these prompted models retain most of their reasoning capability (4–8pp average accuracy cost vs 20–29pp for no reasoning at all) while moving it into the stylistically controllable channel.
